macros.name: menu
macros.doc: Macro \menu{⟨icon⟩}{⟨shortcut⟩} draws an icon from the main menu.

macros.name: setgraphcolor
macros.doc: default color can be redefined at any time using macro \setgraphcolor{⟨color⟩}.

macros.name: tikzbattery
macros.doc: Macro \tikzbattery[⟨options⟩]{⟨state⟩}{⟨coordinates⟩} is identical to macro \battery, but from within a TikZ environment.

macros.name: tikzbattery
macros.doc: Macro \tikzbattery[⟨options⟩]{⟨state⟩}{⟨coordinates⟩} is identical to macro \battery, but from within a TikZ environment.

macros.name: tikzcalculator
macros.doc: One can include a calculator in a TikZ drawing, using command \tikzcalculator{⟨model⟩}. This command takes a single argument {⟨model⟩}, and displays a calculator around coordinates (0; 0).

macros.name: tikzfunction
macros.doc: Macro \tikzfunction[⟨options⟩]{⟨function⟩}{⟨coordinates⟩} is the same as \function, but from within a TikZ environment.

macros.name: tikzfunction
